title: Path-aware test sharding and DepBot integration to reduce CI costs
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: CI costs and queue time have trended up as test suites grew and we run full matrices for every change. This PR introduces path-aware test selection, map-based shard assignment and an opt-in selective-rerun helper so CI runs only the tests that may be impacted by a change. In parallel we wire DepBot (internal dependency-bumping bot) configuration into the pipeline to gate autoprun PRs through the new lightweight shard+path flow. What changed: added ci/test-map.json and a small test-mapper service that maps file globs to test shards; changed .github/workflows/ci.yml to compute affected shards on PRs and to dispatch only those shards; added scripts/ci/selective-rerun.sh for on-demand reruns when flaky tests are narrowed down; introduced tools/depbot/config.yaml to standardize autoprun labels and required checks; optimized Dockerfile.ci to reduce layer churn and speed image builds for ephemeral runners; added caching for test-map lookup and per-shard test caches to reduce redundant work. Rollout plan: feature gated behind repo setting ci.path_shard_enabled (off by default), gradual enable for redwood/* packages by default for non-release branches, monitor cost and false-negative rate, revert via feature flag if needed. Backwards compatibility: unchanged for callers; default behavior preserved until flag enabled. Testing: manual runs against recent large PRs, smoke on main, e2e against a synthetic repo to validate mapping heuristics, and canary rollout to 10% of PRs using the feature flag. Impact: expected 30-55% reduction in average CI runner-seconds for small changes, faster feedback for small teams and lower queue times for high-activity windows. Related: references ENG-4321 and ENG-4402 for test-mapper design and DepBot gating policy. Notes: this PR focuses on pipeline and infra changes only; it does not alter test code or add flakiness fixes. See files_changed_list for details.
commits_summary: 5 commits: create test-map and mapper service; wire path-based shard computation into ci workflow; selective rerun script and CLI; DepBot config and autoprun gating; Dockerfile.ci layering and cache tweaks
review_comments: Evan Liu: Can we make the mapper tolerant of newly added test files that don't appear in the test-map yet? Add a fallback that runs the full relevant package shard.
Maya Patel (author): Added fallback logic and a telemetry metric to track fallback usage. Also added a simple regeneration script for the map.
Carlos Mendes: Left a few nits around the Dockerfile ordering and one concurrency race in the rerun script. Please address before merging.
Maya Patel (author): Fixed Docker layering and serialized the critical section in selective-rerun.sh. Re-ran the full CI matrix for verification.
Priya Rao: Verified DepBot config matches org policy and approved; recommend a canary rollout 10% before org-wide enablement.
CI Bot: unit-shard-2 failed on first run due to a flaky test; selective rerun targeted the failing test and passed on re-run.
release_notes: Introduce path-aware test sharding and DepBot CI gating to reduce CI runtime for small changes. Opt-in via ci.path_shard_enabled. Improves CI cost and feedback latency.
